Thank fucking god they brought back the folding element of the headphones. It was a dealbreaker for me when the XM5 was announced, as I wanted to fold it to make it compact in my backpack and not take up real estate for other things I needed.

Labs feedback: I get wanting to show the charts for each headphone separately, but I think it would be a nice addition to give a version of each chart that has both XM5 and XM6 on the same chart. Or even one where the XM5 is neutralized as the target and then the XM6 is presented as the difference from target - this probably only makes sense for the ANC measurements but would likely better showcase the differences Linus noted in mids for ANC. 

Also, for this specific headphone, I bet I'm not the only person with XM4s that saw the XM5 lost the fold feature and never upgraded because of it. It would be really useful to show XM4 vs XM6 which would probably have even starker improvements to highlight, which would then help XM4 owners decide if this is finally the one to upgrade to. Similar to how in GPU charts it's useful to include a couple older cards - many people don't upgrade every year, so only showing the difference between last year's cards and the new card is not as useful since it means the viewer has to try to do mental math or additional research to grok the potential upgrade value.
